# Arrays

Array fixtures cover dynamic arrays, fixed-size arrays, literal commitment, and cross-module forwarding behavior.

## Coverage

- `dynamic.md`: Dynamic array assignability and indexing behavior.
- `sized.md`: Fixed-size array assignability and compatibility behavior.
- `literals.md`: Array literal commitment in annotated and unannotated positions.
- `modules.md`: Cross-module preservation for dynamic and fixed-size array types.
